about: What both installers do, case by case: `npx find-session install` (npm/find-session.js) and
scripts/install_skill.py. tests/npm/find-session.test.js and tests/test_install_skill.py run every
case in an empty temporary home and compare the lines the installer prints per tool.
dirs: directories created first. foreign: a folder holding some other skill. other_install: a
find-session skill folder (version 9.9.9) put there by another installer. links: link -> target.
out: the per-tool lines, in order; {skill} is the installer's own skill folder, a trailing * matches
any ending. linked: tools whose link must point at the installer's own skill afterwards.
absent: paths that must not exist afterwards. stderr: text the error output must contain.
plugin: find-session installed as a Claude Code plugin: a skill folder (9.9.9) under `path`/skills and
an entry in .claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json with that install path and `scope`; `disabled`

cases.name: only the tools that exist are linked
out: claude: linked ~/.claude/skills/find-session
codex: skipped, Codex not found (add --harness codex to install anyway)
omp: skipped, omp not found (add --harness omp to install anyway)

cases.name: all three tools
out: claude: linked ~/.claude/skills/find-session
codex: linked ~/.codex/skills/find-session
omp: linked ~/.omp/agent/skills/find-session

cases.name: --harness links a tool that is not there and says why the others are skipped
out: claude: skipped, not named with --harness
codex: skipped, not named with --harness
omp: linked ~/.omp/agent/skills/find-session

cases.name: --harness given twice
out: claude: linked ~/.claude/skills/find-session
codex: linked ~/.codex/skills/find-session
omp: skipped, not named with --harness

cases.name: no tool at all
cases.stderr: no Claude Code, Codex or omp directory found (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.omp)

cases.name: --dry-run changes nothing
out: dry-run: claude: would link ~/.claude/skills/find-session -> {skill}
codex: skipped, Codex not found (add --harness codex to install anyway)
omp: skipped, omp not found (add --harness omp to install anyway)

cases.name: a different skill with the same name is a conflict
out: claude: conflict: ~/.claude/skills/find-session is a different skill, kept (use --replace)
codex: linked ~/.codex/skills/find-session
omp: skipped, omp not found (add --harness omp to install anyway)

cases.name: --replace moves the different skill to a backup
out: claude: linked, previous one moved to ~/.claude/skill-backups/find-session-*
codex: skipped, Codex not found (add --harness codex to install anyway)
omp: skipped, omp not found (add --harness omp to install anyway)

cases.name: a find-session installed another way is kept, not a conflict
out: claude: kept, already installed from ~/src/find-session/skills/find-session (9.9.9); --replace links this one instead
codex: linked ~/.codex/skills/find-session
omp: skipped, omp not found (add --harness omp to install anyway)
